gloss: timeliness; quality of delivering breaking news quickly

definitions.gloss: timeliness; ability to deliver news or information quickly
definitions.explanation: The quality of reporting or sharing information rapidly, especially news. Used to describe the characteristic of media, social platforms, or services that excel at delivering breaking information before others.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{速報性|そくほうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧{速報性|そくほうせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{劣|おと}る→劣る：02025_otoru⟧。
examples.english: Newspapers are inferior to television in terms of timeliness.

examples.japanese: {速報性|そくほうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧あまり、{誤報|ごほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a risk that overemphasizing timeliness leads to more false reports.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {速報性|そくほうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: has high timeliness
- {速報性|そくほうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧: to prioritize speed of reporting
- {速報性|そくほうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to excel in timeliness

USAGE:
Frequently used when comparing media channels (SNS, TV, newspapers). The suffix -性 turns the noun ⟦{速報|そくほう}→速報：14319_sokuhou⟧ (breaking news; flash report) into an abstract quality noun meaning 'the property of being fast-reporting'.
